_comment: What must be true before a first visit can unlock a ring (put it in the travel log). build_rings.py copies each ring's 'all' list into rings.json as 'unlock' (type, var id or quest, op, value, label). The plugin reads these vars locally while the dials are open (UnlockCheck): quest = net.runelite.api.Quest constant name and the QuestState it must reach; varbit = client.getVarbitValue(id); varp = client.getVarpValue(id); unknown = needed but not checkable from the client, shown as a hint and never treated as met or failed. A condition with confidence 'low' must be of type 'unknown'. Labels read after 'needs' (e.g. 'Locked - needs Regicide'). Agility and greegree gates only limit using a ring, not unlocking it, so they are not here (they stay in ring_display.json requirements). 'name' is the gameval constant for the id, checked by RingDataTest. Researched 2026-10-04 (sources per condition).

all.label: Beneath Cursed Sands progress
all.why: The wiki says AKP unlocks when Maisa's cutscene takes you to the Necropolis. Quest Helper stages 6-12 are the talk with Maisa and the cutscene; 14 is inspecting the blocked entry at the Jaltevas Pyramid, inside the Necropolis.
